WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND u.tenant_id <> '0' AND t.deleted = 0 AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.is_super_role = '1'
AND t.tenant_code LIKE concat('%', #{tenantCode}, '%')
AND t.tenant_name LIKE concat('%', #{tenantName}, '%')

mapper.select:
SELECT u.id AS userId, u.tenant_id AS tenantId, t.tenant_code AS tenantCode, t.tenant_name AS tenantName, t.tenant_type AS tenantType, u.username AS username, u.nickname AS nickname, r.role_code AS roleCode, r.role_name AS roleName, u.status AS status, u.login_fail_count AS loginFailCount, u.locked_until AS lockedUntil, u.last_login_at AS lastLoginAt, u.must_change_password AS mustChangePassword, u.mfa_enabled AS mfaEnabled FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_tenant t ON t.id = u.tenant_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.tenant_id = u.tenant_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.tenant_id = u.tenant_id
ORDER BY t.tenant_code ASC, u.username ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_tenant t ON t.id = u.tenant_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.tenant_id = u.tenant_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.tenant_id = u.tenant_id
